newsitem.title: USA: FCC approves SBC acquisition of Pacific Telesis.
newsitem.headline: FCC approves SBC acquisition of Pacific Telesis.

text.p: The Federal Communications Commission has approved the $16.5 billion acquisition of Pacific Telesis Group by SBC Corp., the parent of regional phone company Southwestern Bell, the companies said Friday.

San Antonio, Texas-based SBC and Pacific Telesis, which is headquarters in San Francisco, announced the deal April 1. The companies serve the nation's two most populous states and seven of its 10 largest metropolitan areas. Together, the two companies 1996 revenues totalled $23.5 billion.
